scope: Two-timescale change detection on synthetic 240-point signals with noise ±0.26, drift slope +0.005, abrupt step +3 at t120 and isolated impulses ±7.

calibration.disclosure: Selected after viewing calibration results; these are not independent holdout results.

fast_channel: SG024 rolling 11 median, displacement >1.15 for 4 consecutive windows, 16-step cooldown; step label requires matching adjacent jump >1.5 in trailing 20.
slow_channel: Compare medians of 48 preceding observations and 48 most recent observations, threshold absolute median difference >0.20 over 5 confirmations; 20-step cooldown; ignore slow drift alarms within 70 samples of fast step alarm.

holdout.seeds: Thirty unseen seeds per type: 510000+53*i+1009*kind_index; 150 streams
holdout.success_criteria: Stable/spike: no alerts; drift: >=1 drift alert, no step; steps: >=1 step alert between t120..145 and no uncancelled drift alarms
holdout.scoring: One primary category pass/fail per trace, report all false alarms and misses; no retuning after freeze

limitations: Class membership used for evaluation, not detector
Suppression of drift near step could mask real concurrent drift
Synthetic setting, known type patterns, not arbitrary stochastic processes
